name: Spotmaniac Dog Pedigree
author: angelneychev

sections.description:
Spotmaniac Dog Pedigree is a focused dog catalog plugin for breeders and kennel websites. It registers a Dog custom post type with 22 standard fields (name, sex, color, dates, registration numbers, microchip, tattoo, etc.), publishes a responsive catalog page with filters, and renders a clean single-dog page that you can fully restyle by overriding the templates from your theme.

Manage Dogs

  • Custom post type with 22 standard fields
  • Photo upload via the WordPress Media Library
  • Parents (sire / dam) with autocomplete search
  • Owner field with optional WordPress user link
  • Custom dropdown fields you can define yourself

Public Catalog

  • Responsive card grid at /dogs/ (URL prefix configurable)
  • Search by name
  • Filters by sex, color, breeding status
  • Built-in pagination
  • No page creation needed — works as soon as you activate

Single Dog Pages

  • Photo + key info hero layout
  • Color-coded badges for sex and status
  • Configurable sections: Basic Info, Identification, Health
  • Litter mates section automatically derived from parents
  • Drag-and-drop section reordering in settings
  • Toggle visibility of any field

Settings

  • Configure dropdown values for Color, Size, Breeding Status
  • Visual repeater UI — add, remove, reorder options
  • Add custom dropdown fields
  • Set URL prefix, items per page, default sort order
  • Photo size limit

Developer Friendly

  • Template override from your theme: copy any template to your-theme/spotmaniac-dog-pedigree/
  • Clean CSS classes on every element (.dogped-*)
  • REST API at /wp-json/spotmaniac-dog-pedigree/v1/
  • Action and filter hooks throughout
  • Translation-ready (POT file included)

Shortcodes

  • [dogped-catalog] — Embed a filterable catalog on any page
  • [dogped-featured count="6"] — Show featured dogs randomly

Add-on

If you need pedigree trees, multi-breed taxonomy, CSV import/export, structured health tests, breeder roles with a frontend dashboard, or Schema.org SEO, the Spotmaniac Dog Pedigree Pro add-on adds those features. It is a separate plugin sold at https://dogspedigree.lemonsqueezy.com/. The free plugin works fully on its own.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/spotmaniac-dog-pedigree/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save Changes.
  4. Your catalog is live at /dogs/ (or whatever URL prefix you set).
  5. Go to Dogs → Add New Dog to add your first dog.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create pages?

No. The /dogs/ archive and individual dog pages are created automatically by the plugin.

Can I change the URL prefix?

Yes. Go to Dogs → Settings → URL Prefix. After changing, go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The plugin uses minimal CSS and inherits your theme’s typography and form styles. You can also override any template by copying it to your-theme/spotmaniac-dog-pedigree/.

How do I add dropdown options like colors?

Go to Dogs → Settings → Dropdown Field Options. Use the + Add button to add options. You can also create custom dropdown fields beyond the built-in ones.

Can I edit dogs from the front end?

The REST API supports an owner-update endpoint that lets a logged-in owner edit a limited set of fields (photo, titles, color, call name, description) on dogs they own.

How do I uninstall?

Deactivating leaves data intact. Deleting the plugin removes all dog posts, meta, options, and transients.
